svg.title: Figure 2 · Every run over time
svg.desc: Altitude and PX4 mode over time for every run, with the keep-out
svg.text: Altitude above the dock against time after the injection, coloured by PX4 mode, with the keep-out altitude (8 m) dashed. Red ticks mark samples inside the pilot keep-out:
below that altitude and within 3 m of the pilot station.
Altitude axis 0–33 m above the dock; dotted line: the first failsafe mode change.

Generated by tools/figures/uavresults_readme.py from the PX4 SITL result files, their summary and the harness that writes them. Synthetic simulation output; design aid only, no evidence credit (sim/README.md, evidence gate).

g.text: Terms: PX4 = PX4 Autopilot, the open-source flight-control software candidate for SUS-A1 · SITL = software-in-the-loop simulation · SU-nnn = UAV PX4 SITL scenario · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · UAV = uncrewed
